description: Distinct LIVE_OK Back H3BUP orders in cohort by order_id
filters: status=LIVE_OK; exec_side=back; policy_version contains H3BUP_vNext; exclude heartbeat
null_policy: MISSING if source failed; 0 only if healthy empty cohort
freshness_requirement: executor jsonl mtime within report freshness gate

description: Settled P&L over settled stake; open excluded from denominator
filters: LIVE_OK cohort ∩ settled accounting; exclude open; void/push pnl=0 stake included
null_policy: UNAVAILABLE_STALE if accounting STALE; MISSING if join fails; INSUFFICIENT_N if n<min
dedup_rule: one accounting pnl per order_id (lifetime sum P&L-like)
statistical_status_rule: INSUFFICIENT_N if n_settled < 30 for inference; AVAILABLE for descriptive

description: Legacy Daily V1: sum(pnl_ledger)/sum(exposure_exec)*100 for Back LIVE_OK on created_at day; includes open if present in ledger
filters: Back LIVE_OK; pnl-like ledger rows; deposits/withdrawals excluded
null_policy: None/— if den=0; missing oid excluded from num/den

description: Same formula as v1 but reports open/settled/void/missing splits; principal performance metric remains roi_settled
formula: (sum pnl_settled / sum stake_settled) * 100 when settled; else status PARTIAL
null_policy: PARTIAL if open remain; MISSING if no accounting

filters: pre_submit_ms <= 6000; missing => not classified as slow or fast
null_policy: MISSING pre_submit_ms => separate NA bucket; never coerce to slow

description: Exploratory study bucket pre_submit_ms < 4000; never replaces Daily fast
Forward CLV strict valid for POST_5M window after activation
filters: forward-only; same event/market/period/side/line; before kickoff for closing
null_policy: INSUFFICIENT_N / NOT_DUE / MISSING — never 0 by default

description: Fair edge / de-vig not implemented in Phase 2R
End-to-end latency from WS detect to LIVE_OK via h3bup_e2e_trace
filters: schema_version=1; dedupe trace_id; status LIVE_OK subset for this metric
null_policy: INSUFFICIENT_N if n=0; never compute percentiles on empty
